'''Ines''' is a noble born Lady.

== Appearance ==
She is darkly handsome, with a long hard face, which is well practiced in anger.

== Activities ==
She is part of [[Darlin Sisnera]]'s rebellion that is situated in [[Haddon Mirk]]. She is with Darlin when they find [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Min Farshaw]] in the woods. She is forced to give her horse to Min to ride.
